purpose: Four-layer runtime for a diagram-backed model. A new hunt is a new PUML document plus a PumlHost, not a new engine.

layers.name: Model
layers.role: Common evaluate surface. Any scoring or hunt model.

layers.name: PumlModel
layers.role: A Model whose policy is a parsed PlantUML activity document.

layers.name: PumlModelFactory
layers.role: Pure: PUML text in, PumlModel out. No I/O. Fail closed on unknown activity syntax.

layers.name: PumlEngine
layers.role: Interprets the document. Does not encode hunt arithmetic or hunt labels. Named phrases the diagram does not define go to PumlHost.

host.name: PumlHost
host.role: Document vocabulary. The only hunt-specific Kotlin for a PUML-backed model.
host.decorateEmit: decorateEmit(name, fields, env, flags, document) -> fields. Default is identity. A host may fill empty emit fields (Watch reason).

emission.name: PascalCase box label
emission.fields: arg and/or reason copied from the box, plus host decorateEmit

activityDialect.bareCall: non-emit activity box with no = or ←; host.evaluate
activityDialect.tables: A note header 'key, first match:' plus numbered rows becomes document.tables[key]. The engine does not interpret the table.

invariants: Engine.run walks the activity graph and does not hard-code hunt formulas or hunt labels.
A process loads each PUML source once at start. A restart sees edits. Mid-run reload is out of scope.
Tape, Street consensus EPS, and Quant Engine stay out unless a document names them.
A new hunt is a new PUML document plus a PumlHost.
